requirements.statement: A user signs in through the organization's single sign-on before accessing their todos

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before seeing any todo list
After signing in, the user lands on their own todo list

requirements.statement: A user can add a new todo with a title

criteria.must: Submitting a title creates a new todo that appears in the user's list
A new todo starts as not-completed

requirements.statement: A user can view their list of todos

criteria.must: The user's todo list screen shows every todo they have created
A todo list shows only the signed-in user's own todos, never another user's

requirements.statement: A user can mark a todo as complete or incomplete

criteria.must: Marking a todo complete updates its status and is reflected in the list
Marking a completed todo incomplete reverses its status

requirements.statement: A user can edit a todo's title

criteria.must: Editing a todo's title and saving updates the title shown in the list

requirements.statement: A user can delete a todo

criteria.must: Deleting a todo removes it from the user's list

requirements.statement: A user's todos persist across sessions and devices

criteria.must: A todo created in one session is still present after signing out and signing back in
A todo created from one device or browser session is visible when the same user signs in elsewhere
